office_does: The sheriff leads law enforcement in Lincoln County, including patrol, the jail and civil process.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Gabe Gants, with the office since 2004 and sheriff since 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lincoln County Sheriff since a 2022 appointment, with the sheriff's office since 2004; former Davenport council and school board member.
highlights: With the sheriff's office since 2004 in dispatch, corrections, patrol and as sergeant [S1]
Interim sheriff from July 2022, elected that November [S3][S8]
Columns stress staffing and technology upgrades [S6][S7]
